hero.headline: Leaders in Industrial Inspection & NDT in Argentina
hero.subtitle: GF Inspecciones y Ensayos provides cutting-edge non-destructive testing and industrial inspection services, ensuring the integrity, safety, and reliability of your critical assets.

about.title: About GF Inspecciones y Ensayos
about.description: With over 10 years of experience in the industrial inspection sector, GF Inspecciones y Ensayos has established itself as a trusted partner for companies operating in the most demanding industries across Argentina and the region. Our team of certified professionals holds internationally recognized qualifications and is deeply committed to delivering results that meet the highest standards of quality and safety. We combine technical expertise with a client-focused approach to provide solutions that protect both people and assets.

integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.description: We conduct every inspection with honesty, transparency, and strict adherence to technical and ethical standards.

precision.title: Precision
precision.description: Accurate, reliable results are at the heart of what we do — because in our field, details make all the difference.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.description: We continuously adopt the latest technologies and methodologies to deliver superior inspection outcomes.

safety.title: Safety
safety.description: The safety of our team, our clients, and the public is non-negotiable and guides every decision we make.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: We offer a comprehensive range of industrial inspection and non-destructive testing services tailored to meet the specific needs of each client and industry.

ndt.title: Non-Destructive Testing (NDT)
ndt.description: We apply advanced NDT techniques to detect and characterize defects without affecting the integrity of the tested component. Our capabilities include phased array ultrasonics (PAUT), industrial radiography (RT), eddy current testing (ET), and dye penetrant inspection (PT), among others.

welding.title: Welding Inspection
welding.description: Our certified welding inspectors ensure full compliance with applicable codes and standards. Services include weld certification, procedure and welder qualification, and development or review of Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS) and Procedure Qualification Records (PQR).

pressure_vessel.title: Pressure Vessel Inspection
pressure_vessel.description: We perform thorough in-service and pre-commissioning inspections of pressure vessels, piping, and process systems in accordance with ASME codes, national regulations, and client specifications to ensure safe and reliable operation.

corrosion.title: Corrosion Assessment
corrosion.description: Our corrosion specialists assess the condition of industrial assets through wall thickness measurement, corrosion mapping, and degradation analysis. We provide remaining life estimates and actionable recommendations to support maintenance planning and asset longevity.

asset_integrity.title: Asset Integrity Management
asset_integrity.description: We support operators in developing and implementing risk-based inspection (RBI) plans, providing technical consulting, and establishing quality assurance programs that maximize asset availability while minimizing risk and operational costs.

laser_scanning.title: 3D Laser Scanning
laser_scanning.description: Using high-precision 3D laser scanning technology, we capture accurate as-built data for industrial facilities and components. Applications include 3D modeling, dimensional analysis, deformation monitoring, and reverse engineering for maintenance and project planning.

projects.label: Projects
projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of completed projects that reflect our technical expertise and commitment to excellence across diverse industries.

petrochemical.title: Petrochemical Plant Inspection
petrochemical.description: Comprehensive NDT and integrity inspection campaign across multiple process units at a major petrochemical complex, including PAUT, radiography, and corrosion mapping of critical piping and pressure vessels.

pipeline.title: Pipeline Integrity Program
pipeline.description: Design and execution of a risk-based pipeline integrity management program for an oil & gas transmission operator, covering inline inspection data analysis, corrosion assessment, and fitness-for-service evaluations.

refinery.title: Refinery Turnaround Inspection
refinery.description: Full-scope inspection services during a planned shutdown at a regional refinery, encompassing pressure vessel internal inspections, welding quality control, and post-repair NDT verification in compliance with API and ASME standards.
